title: Phone app layout and Filters sheet speed
body: List rows, fonts, the tab bar and the Filters sheet in the phone app now look as designed, and the Filters sheet opens much faster.
reason: Fixes in the unreleased Expo app under mobile/ (the mobile-app flag stays false). The only shared change is an optional facet list on core's facetCounts and eventFacetCounts; the website calls them without it, so its behaviour is unchanged.
